correctness.rationale: Reconstruct the rank-one form \(R(x)=\operatorname{tr}(wx)v\); the original Rota-Baxter identity is exactly \([w,v]\in kw\). The one-dimensional sl2 centralizer and nilpotent normalizer prove two incidence components; binary quadratic factorization gives \(\mathbb P^2\) and \(\mathbb P^1\times\mathbb P^1\) meeting in a conic. Exact projective point counts and PGL2 stabilizers prove all odd-q counts/orbit sizes. Four field checks including F9, and two exhaustive orbit checks, reproduce the formulas. Nonreduced scheme not asserted.

value.rationale: Rank-one solutions form a natural geometric first stratum of the quadratic Rota-Baxter/CYBE operator equation on the smallest simple Lie algebra. A complete reduced two-component incidence model, exact arithmetic counts, and all rational conjugacy orbit sizes constitute a structural and computable invariant; split, nonsplit and nilpotent square-class phenomena distinguish rational points in ways invisible to complex matrix normal forms. The rank-one restriction has a motivated object/invariant, not an arbitrary slice.
